ctx.x: I see. Did -- does the name Walter Dyett, Captain Walter Dyett ring a bell? It was -- do you thing that your uncle might have known him? He was a music teacher in Chicago, and he taught at the Du Sable High School for many, many years. From a -- this may have been a little after the, the time that you were studying with your uncle, but he studied and taught there from about the '20s into the 1950s.
